citation.verbatim: theorem addHaar_sphere (μ : Measure X) [IsAddHaarMeasure μ] {c : X} {r : ℝ} (hr : r ≠ 0) : μ (sphere c r) = 0 — in a finite-dimensional real normed space of dimension at least 2 (here ℂ, finrank 2), the sphere of positive radius is Haar-null; companion Mathlib lemmas used in the derivation: measure_singleton, measure_biUnion_null_iff, Real.volume_closedBall.

claim: CONDITIONAL on the Mathlib addHaar_sphere theorem: no countable family of circles covers the closed unit disk (the lemniscate of f(z)=z, planar measure π > 0); hence the circle-worded frozen contract is false as written — the countable-union step of lemma L1; the per-circle nullness is anchored to the cited axiom, the covering refutation is derived in the proof.
